item.title: 08 Nov 2026 10:30
item.description:
ASKY is one of the more reliable airlines in West Africa. They however keep shifting their flight schedules quite frequently. During our last trip to Malabo they altered the schedule last minute and we had to fly all the way down to Addis to get back to Yaounde. During both our onward and return flights this time we had to fly via Lome. Travel to constituents is such a pain here in Africa at times.

Just got back from a short walk in and around Parque Nacional. This is just a couple minutes from the hotel and is actually quite a well maintained park. Nothing in Yaounde comes close to this, so I’m glad we did get out this Sunday morning. The heat’s real but nothing too much to handle.

It’s highly likely we might know where we’re headed next year by end of this week. Exciting! Just really hope it’s one of those places with easy access to the outdoors.

It’s Diwali today! And one like none other. I should really plan and block these days on my calendar. Would have been real nice just being at home today. I’d like to eat something wicked delicious. One of those lip-smacking Biryani’s? or Maybe a real well done Mysore Masasla Dosa and Sambhar from that Krishna Udipi Bhawan in Vidyanagar. For today though, I’ll have to settle in for a pizza slice that’s microwave heated well beyond it’s heat-point and served on a plastic plate….

Spent some time tweaking this site to reflect a few things I’ve had in my mind. Ever since I started the model rail project, I’ve spent way little time here. Every hobby gives and takes I guess! 🔗
